draft.subject: Your SSO question — plus getting your first project up
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for your question about SSO — your ticket is still open on our side, and the short answer is that SSO is available on the Team plan. Happy to pass along anything else your IT team needs.

In the meantime, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so creating your first one is the quickest way to see it in action. You can also invite a teammate from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through both with you.

Best,
Priya
